# FINAL IMAGE GENERATION PROMPT
## 1. Objective Summary
Create a premium {format} for {category/campaign}, built around a single hero object or subject: {hero subject}. The image should feel {style}.

## 2. Creative References
Use the shared Description of references for inspiration only. Do not copy layouts, artwork, exact text, logos, or unique subjects.

## 3. Core Style Rules
Theme: {theme}
Color palette: {color palette}

## 4. Composition Specification
Composition: {composition}
Dimensions: {dimensions}
Define hero placement, scale, background, lighting, materials, atmosphere, supporting elements, and visual hierarchy.

## 5. Negative Prompt
Avoid clutter, multiple focal points, flat lighting, poor spacing, inconsistent reflections, low-quality materials, irrelevant decorative elements, and unwanted cropping.
